foundation.body1: ENI wasn't built to launch a token. It was built to run real commercial systems at enterprise scale.
foundation.body2: Full EVM compatibility, 1-click AppChains, and native MiCA/GDPR compliance. Complete with an SDK, API suite, and governance templates from day one.
foundation.arch01Desc: Parallel computing + three-layer composite consensus (EPoS + VRF + ETurboBFT). Each AppChain independently exceeds 10,000 TPS. Cluster scale unlimited.
foundation.arch02Desc: RWA settlement, high-frequency clearing, payments, IoT event processing. Use cases ENI was designed for — not adapted to.
foundation.arch03Desc: Existing contracts migrate at zero cost. SDK, API, governance templates, and monitoring all included.
foundation.arch04Title: MiCA · GDPR · PDPO — Compliance built in
foundation.arch04Desc: Enterprise compliance ships with the chain — not retrofitted after deployment.
daoaas.body: Most growth programs create activity in dashboards. DAOaaS creates activity on-chain. ASEAN Labs operates ENI's native DAO-as-a-Service platform — connecting verified user behavior to on-chain rewards, protocol adoption, and real TVL growth.
daoaas.produces1: On-chain activity that shows up in block explorers — not just in community dashboards.
daoaas.produces2: TVL growth tied to real user behavior. Measurable via wallet interactions and contract calls.
daoaas.produces3: A community with governance rights and long-term protocol alignment — users who stay.
daoaas.produces4: Metrics your investors can verify without asking for screenshots.

process.pageDesc: We qualify first, then we build. See how ASEAN Labs works with projects.
process.subtitle: ASEAN Labs doesn't take every project. We take the ones we can deliver results for, and we're upfront about which ones qualify. If your project doesn't, we tell you on the first call, along with what would need to change.
process.step01Desc: We review your project's stage, product readiness, team strength, and fit with ENI. You get a clear yes or no within 48 hours.
process.step02Desc: We define exactly what we deliver, the timeline, and the measurable outcomes. Nothing starts until the scope is locked.
process.step03Desc: Every engagement is paid and formally contracted, with KPIs agreed in writing. We don't do handshake deals.
process.step04Desc: We assign a dedicated team and start work immediately. You have a single point of contact from day one.
process.step05Desc: We execute and report. Every metric is traceable on-chain or documented, so you always know what's happening.
process.standard1Desc: Every engagement is priced, scoped, and contracted. We do not work on token allocations, equity swaps, or promises of future upside. High-standard execution requires committed resources from both sides.
process.standard2Desc: We don't inflate numbers, whether that's community size, event attendance, or on-chain activity. Every figure we report is traceable or documented, and our reputation depends on it.
process.standard3Desc: A structured, paid engagement covering community, operations, content, design, development, events, and regional distribution, all held to agreed KPIs. We reward real outcomes rather than milestone submissions.
why.pageDesc: Southeast Asia is already an active Web3 market, and ASEAN Labs is on the ground there.
why.desc1: ASEAN Labs has spent years building here, on the ground. Our distribution is built into the region, our community is verified, and our teams work in their native languages. We have relationships at every layer: retail users, institutional partners, developer communities, and regional KOLs.
why.desc2: A project that arrives with a marketing budget and no local context can't replicate this. Work with ASEAN Labs and you join a network of 100+ ecosystem projects, an events operation that has run 150+ activations, and operators who know this market because they built it.
why.adv1Desc: Verified participants with real on-chain activity across Southeast Asia's core markets.
why.adv2Desc: A track record that is public and verifiable, so you can check it yourself.
why.adv3Desc: English, Chinese, Malay, Thai, Japanese, Korean, and Mandarin, handled by native speakers rather than translators. Real regional distribution depends on that.

ecosystem.t1.desc: Drinking tea has become a way of life. The top-tier of Pu'er tea, a 2,700-year-old Pu'er tea asset, will be put on-chain to enhance the value creation of this tangible asset.
ecosystem.t1.testimony: "Love how they're bridging real-world assets into Web3. It actually gives holding the token a tangible, grounded feeling."
ecosystem.t2.desc: Hotlink DAO (Hotlink Global Education DAO) evolved from a leading blockchain education group in China and is dedicated to building a global Web3 educational super-system.
ecosystem.t2.testimony: "Finally an education DAO that feels structured. Their onboarding materials made transitioning our Web2 devs so much smoother."
ecosystem.t3.desc: The game-powered Rewards Distribution Hub — Farm with your Pet TOFUs, earn points, and redeem for exclusive rewards like Stablecoins on LINE.
ecosystem.t3.testimony: "Super addictive loop. Farming with the pet TOFUs is chill, and actually being able to redeem for stablecoins is a huge plus."
ecosystem.t4.desc: Helios is a quantitative trading and liquidity infrastructure provider and the official market maker for the ENI ecosystem. Leveraging advanced algorithms, AI-driven execution, and institutional-grade risk controls.
ecosystem.t4.testimony: "Solid liquidity and tight spreads. We integrated their market-making infra last month and the execution has been flawless."
ecosystem.t5.desc: Yochis are pixel penguins living on ENI Island — each one uniquely styled with outfits, props, and vibes. No roles, no rules — just pure self-expression and good times.
ecosystem.t5.testimony: "The vibes here are unmatched. My pixel penguin is my forever PFP—just a really fun, low-stress community to be part of."
ecosystem.t6.desc: A perpetual protocol defining financial civilization. Integrating RWA aggregation, decentralized prediction markets, and a unified consensus layer on the ENI Chain.
ecosystem.t6.testimony: "Their prediction market UI is clean. It's refreshing to see RWA aggregation done in a way that makes sense for retail users."
ecosystem.t7.desc: BlackRock Protocol 🏛 | AI × RWA × CATC | Smart Finance powered by AI, real assets & Catcoin intelligence.
ecosystem.t7.testimony: "AI plus RWAs sounded like buzzwords until I used their platform. The smart finance features are genuinely useful."
ecosystem.t8.desc: $CELA - Gamify Asset Issuance Using vPoW Mechanism. Backed by BinanceLabs & OKX_ventures.
ecosystem.t8.testimony: "vPoW is an interesting concept for asset issuance. It feels much fairer than traditional mints, and the Binance Labs backing is huge."
ecosystem.t9.desc: Plug Intelligence into Web3, One Command at a Time. An AI-native infrastructure that powers Web3 projects with agents and automation.
ecosystem.t9.testimony: "MindKit's AI agents basically automate our entire Discord moderation and on-chain alerts now. Massive time saver for our team."
ecosystem.t10.desc: ZQBTC A computing-power–anchored Web3 infrastructure protocol. Bitcoin mining × on-chain financial systems | ENI Chain.
ecosystem.t10.testimony: "Anchoring infrastructure to Bitcoin mining power is brilliant. It brings a lot of stability and trust to the ecosystem."
ecosystem.t11.desc: Turning real-world consumption into on-chain assets. DeFi 4.0 powered by real consumer data. Building the future of intelligent commerce.
ecosystem.t11.testimony: "Turning everyday consumption into DeFi assets is the holy grail. Arcadia is actually making this usable in the real world."
ecosystem.t12.desc: CyberCharge has created the Next-Gen Global Power Matching Protocol. Enjoy smart #DePIN charging energy services powered by AI and consumer networks.
ecosystem.t12.testimony: "I travel a lot, and finding decentralized charging networks through them has been super convenient. Really cool DePIN use case."
ecosystem.t13.desc: Idle action RPG built for warriors who grind less & win more – fast-paced
ecosystem.t13.testimony: "Perfect game for people with busy schedules. I can grind passively on my phone and still feel like I'm making real progression."
ecosystem.t14.desc: Monster Saga is a P2E turn-based RPG on BSC built around the original Sagas NFT IP. Players collect, battle, and upgrade Saga NFTs to earn MTS rewards in an on-chain gaming ecosystem.
ecosystem.t14.testimony: "The turn-based combat actually requires strategy, not just P2W. Collecting the Saga NFTs has been surprisingly rewarding."
ecosystem.t15.desc: Aurayale is a collectible card battle game featuring strategic combat, progression, and NFT-powered rewards set in a sci-fi universe.
ecosystem.t15.testimony: "The card art is stunning and the deck-building mechanics are deep. Reminds me of Hearthstone but with actual ownership."
ecosystem.t16.desc: Agentic Payments infrastructure on ENI chain enabling native HTTP settlements for APIs, AI Agents, and MCP tools.
ecosystem.t16.testimony: "We use PayGo for all our agentic payments now. The HTTP settlement layer just works—no more struggling with complex integrations."
ecosystem.t17.desc: FlowFi is decentralized treasury infrastructure enabling governed capital coordination on-chain. It provides structured treasury management, programmable governance, and transparent capital execution for DAOs and collective investment networks.
ecosystem.t17.testimony: "Managing our DAO's treasury used to be a nightmare of spreadsheets. FlowFi made everything transparent and easily programmable."
ecosystem.t18.desc: AI-driven Web3 acceleration infrastructure embedding governance, capital efficiency, and structural coordination into category-leading ecosystems.
ecosystem.t18.testimony: "Their acceleration infra really helped us structure our governance tokenomics properly. Top-tier support for serious builders."
ecosystem.t19.desc: The identity layer of DeFi 4.0 — where capital meets structure. MAMA Protocol embeds governance, rewards, and responsibility into a verifiable on-chain identity system.
ecosystem.t19.testimony: "Verifiable on-chain identity is crucial for DeFi right now. Their approach balances user privacy with compliance perfectly."
brand.pageDesc: The brand and visual identity guidelines for ASEAN Labs.
brand.overviewDesc: ASEAN Labs wants to change how people talk about Web3 execution in Southeast Asia. We avoid vague promises and focus on delivery that is transparent, high quality, and backed by data. Our visual identity follows the same idea: Neo-Brutalist, high-contrast, and bold.
brand.personality1Desc: We talk plainly about what it takes to execute on-chain, without fluff or jargon.
brand.personality2Desc: Everything we do is tied to measurable, on-chain outcomes. We value action and results over vanity metrics.
brand.personality3Sub: Easy to spot in a crowded feed
brand.personality3Desc: Our look matches how we work: bold and distinctive, so it doesn't fade into the background.
brand.logosDesc: The ASEAN Labs symbol is a floral matrix that stands for our work as an execution layer: growth, resilience, and connected infrastructure. Use the animated logo where it fits, and don't distort the core symbol.
brand.colorsDesc: Corn yellow is the canvas for every page. Ink carries text, line work and actions. Cyan and paper are reserved for small details inside illustrations. Click a swatch to copy its hex value.
brand.primaryTypefaceDesc: Our primary typeface, used for all titles, headers, and body copy. It is neo-brutalist and slightly eccentric, but stays easy to read.
brand.bodyCopyExample: ASEAN Labs is the execution layer for ENI builders. We qualify first. Then we build.
brand.secondaryTypefaceDesc: Our secondary typeface, used for technical data, badges, metadata, and UI accents. It signals that we are a technical execution partner.
brand.graphicAssetsDesc: Our signature graphic assets include heavy solid borders, sharp offset shadows, and dynamic SVG abstract symbols that react to user interaction. We favor abstract geometric representation over literal illustrations.

from idea to execution.
